comments.note: The WP-031 spec stated 'Scope: MoviesListView.axaml only', but the compiled binding {Binding CoverImageBitmap} requires the property to exist in MoviesListViewModel. The WP-029 spec (work/WP-029.md) listed CoverImageBitmap as a WP-029 deliverable but the prior implementation only completed MovieEditorView tab changes. WP-031 therefore required ViewModel changes as well to meet its own acceptance criteria. This dependency gap was flagged in the WP-029 ledger (AC marked met without matching implementation).

MoviesListViewModel: _coverLoadCts is cancelled and disposed on each SelectedMovie change but is never disposed on class finalization. MoviesListViewModel does not implement IDisposable. If the VM is GC'd with a CTS still in-flight, the CTS memory is leaked. Consider adding IDisposable in a future pass (same issue tracked for MovieEditorViewModel).

MovieEditorViewModel factory in Program.cs (lines 224-238) still does not pass ICoverImageService or the other M9 image services (IThumbnailRepository, IThumbnailGenerationService, IThumbnailViewerService, IFfprobeRunner). This means CoverImageVm, ThumbnailsVm, and GeneratorVm in the editor will always be null in production. This should be addressed in a separate WP.
No improvement observations — MoviesListViewModel.cs code touched in this WP is clean and follows project conventions.
